after.zh: 把掩膜往四个方向各挪一格加起来，再加上自己，只有四面都被围住的格子能数到 5。用一个阈值留下这些「内部」，再从掩膜里减掉，剩下的就是外圈。数邻居再取阈值，后来有个名字叫腐蚀。
after.en: Shift the mask one pixel in each of the four directions, add them up and add the cell itself: only a cell surrounded on all four sides counts to 5. A threshold keeps this "inside", and taking it away from the mask leaves the outer ring. Counting neighbours and then thresholding has a name: erosion.

t.zh: 这是一道挑战关，可以跳过。它不需要新元件，只要把手里的平移、加减和阈值用得更巧。
t.en: This is a challenge level, and you can skip it. It needs no new parts, only a cleverer use of the shifts, sums and threshold you already have.

t.zh: 监控画面上常给闯入者描一圈边，让人一眼看到它的轮廓，又不挡住它本身。
t.en: Security footage often draws an outline round an intruder, so its shape stands out at a glance without hiding it.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：只标出闯入者的外圈，也就是闯入者身上、上下左右至少挨着一格地面的格子。要想的问题：外圈的格子和里面的格子，差别在哪里？
t.en: Your task in this level: mark only the intruder's outer ring, that is, the intruder cells that touch at least one floor cell above, below, left or right. Something to think about: what makes a cell on the ring different from one further in?

caption.zh: 第三组测试：十字形的闯入者和它的外圈
caption.en: Set 3: a cross-shaped intruder and its outer ring

brief.zh: 只描出闯入者的外圈：闯入者身上、上下左右至少挨着一格地面的那些格子输出 1，其余输出 0。图外算地面。
brief.en: Trace only the intruder's outer ring: output 1 on intruder cells that touch at least one floor cell above, below, left or right, and 0 everywhere else. Outside the picture counts as floor.

hint.zh: 先得到闯入者的掩膜。外圈的格子和里面的格子，邻居有什么不同？
hint.en: Get the intruder's mask first. How do the neighbours of a cell on the ring differ from those of a cell further in?
